body.h: On any given beat, the number in a siteswap tells you how many beats later the same object will be thrown again. In a passing pattern with four hands, where one hand throws on each beat, an object is thrown four beats after it is caught. So when you subtract 4 from each number in a siteswap, the numbers in the derived siteswap tell you how many beats later an object will be caught. The arrows in a causal diagram tell you how many beats later an object will be caught.
